formula.beta: 52-week rolling covariance of ETF and SPY log returns divided by SPY variance, minimum 26 observations.
formula.residual: Return at t minus alpha and beta estimated through t-1 applied to SPY return at t.
formula.momentum: Sum residual log returns over 48 weeks after skipping the latest four weeks; cross-sectional winsorized rank to [-1,1], then lag one week.
formula.portfolio: Weekly equal weight top five positive tradable scores; remainder BIL.
formula.vol_management: SPY 13-week realized volatility: 100% exposure at <=18%, 80% at 18-25%, 60% above 25%; remainder BIL.
formula.execution: Signals and SPY volatility through close t determine weights earning t-to-t+1.
formula.blend: Fixed convex blend with causal GGG followed by the 35% risky ETF cap.

decision_rule: Only independently reconstructed standalone sources passing every source gate may support a research-only blend shortlist.
scope_limits: Exactly six candidates; no post-result tuning.
Saved Layer 1 signal values are audit comparators, never portfolio inputs.
Observed history is not untouched evidence; no production promotion or live trading.
